title: 谁在真正执行卡特尔？强化学习在市场中对LLM智能体的教学启示
summary: 提出一种审计方法，通过强制成员在反事实市场中作弊来检验合谋的执行机制，研究强化学习在定价与交易中教会LLM智能体什么。小型LLM学到训练对手所奖励的行为，但仅限于其容易尝试的策略；结果指标无法区分这些情形，审计可以。
summary_en: Introduces an audit that forces a member to cheat in counterfactual market copies to test cartel enforcement, studying what RL teaches LLM agents in pricing and trading. Small RL-trained LLMs learn what rivals reward but only what they readily try; outcome measures cannot distinguish these cases, the audit can.
